description: This file defines data structures, enums, macros, and function declarations for managing WAN MAP domains and rules in a network management context, specifically for the WAN manager component.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of MAP domain entries.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetEntry
methods.description: Gets a specific MAP domain entry by index.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetCfg_Data
methods.description: Retrieves MAP domain configuration data by instance number.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomSetCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetInfo_Data
methods.description: Retrieves MAP domain info data by instance number.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomSetInfo
methods.description: Sets information for a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetNumberOfRules
methods.description: Gets the number of rules associated with a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetRule
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rule for a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetRule_Data
methods.description: Retrieves rule data by domain instance and rule index.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomSetRule
methods.description: Sets a rule for a MAP domain.

methods.name: WanDmlMapDomGetIfStats
methods.description: Retrieves interface statistics for a given interface name.
